sources.rationale: The request proxy carries args, form, headers, cookies, json, data and files — all attacker-chosen. Whole-object tainting matches whole-value granularity; any expression rooted at an import binding of flask.request is tainted.
Parses the attacker-supplied request body; the returned structure is attacker-chosen end to end.
Raw request body bytes, unparsed and fully attacker-chosen.

Binds to extracted route records: path parameters parsed from Flask route patterns arrive as handler arguments chosen by the requester. Confirmation for handler-parameter seeding, not the full census (query and body ride the request object).

sinks.rationale: send_file serves the named filesystem path; an attacker-influenced path reads outside the intended directory (send_from_directory is the guarded form).
Redirecting to an attacker-chosen absolute URL is an open redirect.
